headline: The kettle finishes before the street.
body: Steam fogs the lower pane and clears in a stripe. Outside, the bins stay lined, lids shut. We leave the cup full and the date unwritten.

pulses.label: Sky
pulses.value: low grey, no break at the edges

pulses.label: Light
pulses.value: kettle lamp, a small hard circle

pulses.label: Street
pulses.value: bins lined, lids shut, no one yet
